requirements.quote: A PADDING frame (type=0x00) has no semantic value.  PADDING frames
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the frame as having no semantic effect.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not change protocol semantics or state merely because a PADDING frame was received.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare protocol state and behavior before and after processing a PADDING frame.

requirements.quote:
PADDING frames are formatted as shown in Figure 23, which shows that
   PADDING frames have no content.  That is, a PADDING frame consists of
   the single byte that identifies the frame as a PADDING frame.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a PADDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the frame as exactly one identifying byte with no content fields.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode or interpret content following the identifying byte as part of that PADDING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame length and absence of content fields can be directly validated.

requirements.condition: When encoding or recognizing a PADDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the fixed frame type value 0x00.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not identify a frame with any other type value as a PADDING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame's sole encoded type byte can be checked for the exact value 0x00.
